trust_decision.summary: Which attributes of untrusted HTML survive the HTML5 scrubber is decided by per-tag static allowlists in HTML5 (exact name match via the Meta macro guard); form-association attributes (form, formaction, formenctype, formmethod, formnovalidate, formtarget) were on those lists.

landing_point.why: The summary names the HTML5 scrubber and form-association attributes; the input allowlist with formaction/formmethod/formtarget is the obvious hit for a grep of 'formaction'.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All seven changed lists sit in lib/html_sanitize_ex/scrubber/html5.ex; BasicHTML and MarkdownHTML allow no form-related tags or attributes (grep of lib/html_sanitize_ex/scrubber/basic_html.ex and markdown_html.ex finds none).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The secondary tags (keygen is deprecated, and label's form attribute is obsolete) could be argued irrelevant compared with input's formaction, but they sit in the same file next to each other, so the argument is weak.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Ordinary form controls must keep their non-association attributes (name, type, value, disabled, placeholder) and label must keep 'for'. An over-broad fix that drops input/label/select/textarea tags or strips 'for'/'name' breaks legitimate HTML5 content.

O6_input_shapes: 'form' attribute on input, keygen, label, object, output, select, textarea
formaction / formenctype / formmethod / formnovalidate / formtarget on input

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Route input/button 'formaction' through allow_tag_with_uri_attributes with http/https schemes instead of removing it, so the scheme check passes while a cross-origin destination stays allowed.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The file already scheme-filters input 'src' this way; a maintainer could reasonably think formaction is 'just another URL attribute'. The fix then needs the mechanism understood (destination, not scheme), so this is HOW-type.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A prefix catch-all clause like the data-/aria- ones that also lets 'form'-prefixed attributes through on all tags.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The data-*/aria-* prefix clauses are a pattern a maintainer copies; the solver must look beyond the per-tag lists.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add 'button' and 'fieldset' allowlists (the module claims to allow all HTML5 tags) carrying form/formaction attributes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Both are standard HTML5 form-associated elements missing from the list. This is a WHERE-type sibling, so it counts only as an extra.

O9_family: HTML sanitizer allowlist: form-hijacking attributes (CWE-601-style redirection of form submissions)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Remove only formaction (or the form* attributes) from the input list and miss the 'form' attribute on keygen/label/object/output/select/textarea.
